title: 第19章 复仇改第20章 极阴出关
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
辞别大婶，宋文来到二十五号屋子外。
屋子显得有些破败，看样子，的确是有段时间没人住了。
宋文转身离开了铜锣巷。
大婶说苟航搬走了二十多日，应该就是上次他被唐梁袭击的前后。
足以看出，苟航是个极为谨慎之人，猜到宋文可能会来找他麻烦，提前就搬走了。
宋文回到主道上，路过一家成品服饰店的时候，心思转动，走了进去。
片刻之后，换了一身劲装，头戴斗笠，斗笠边缘有薄纱遮脸，颇有几分江湖侠士的味道。
宋文一路来到，天煞帮门口不远处的一家饭馆，在饭馆二楼靠窗的位置坐下。
这个位置的视野极好，恰好能看到天煞帮的大门。
这一等就是小半日，直到下午时分，他才看到苟航带着两人手下，出了天煞帮。
宋文并没有惊扰三人，而是一直远远的坠在三人后方。
他从下午一直跟到了天黑，也算见识了什么叫真正的流氓。
敲诈小商小贩，吃霸王餐，调戏路边小媳妇，欺压乞丐...
要不是亲眼所见，宋文简直不敢相信，有人能在短短一下午的时间，干出这么多坏事。
最后，三人走进了一家廉价妓院，就在宋文以为自己要在妓院外等很久的时候，结果三人前后不到一刻钟的时间就出来了。
“艹，老虎变的吗？这么快！”
宋文忍不住吐槽了一句，然后借着夜色，尾随三人到了一户民房。
民房有些低矮，一共有三间房间，只有中间的正屋有一扇大门，可以进出。另外两个侧屋，没有通往屋外的房门，只有窗户。
苟航和他的两名手下都是孤家寡人，这段时间，三人平日里就住在这间民房之中。
宋文望了望天色，现在已经过了子时，正是月黑风高杀人时。

宋文整了整衣袖，将手中握住的一包粉末掩饰好之后，迈步上前，直接敲响了房门。
“谁啊？这半夜三更的。”
一名壮汉骂骂咧咧的吼道，一边打开了房门。
“宋...？”
壮汉看到宋文，一脸的吃惊，他想不明白，这么晚了，为何宋文会出现在自家门口。
然而，他的话还没有说出口。
“砰！”
宋文一脚将他踢进了房中，砸落在后方的桌子上。
动静很快吸引了侧房中的两人，苟航和另一名大汉从侧屋中跑出。
看到突兀出现的宋文，苟航大惊失色。
“宋文，你怎么找到这里来了？”
宋文左手一扬，漫天粉末被撒出，直扑苟航而去，瞬间整个正屋中，都弥漫着白色粉末。
这白色粉末是石灰和火碱混合而成。
一时不察的三人瞬间中招。
“啊...我的眼睛...”
三人纷纷用手捂住双眼，连续发出痛苦之声，其中一名大汉眼中更是流出了血水。
“宋文，你个卑鄙小人，你究竟想要干什么？”慌乱之中，苟航一边往后退，一边厉声质问。
苟航还心存一丝侥幸，他并没有和宋文正面产生过冲突，企图瞒天过海，蒙混过关。
content_en:
After saying goodbye to his aunt, Song Wen came outside room 25.
The house looked a bit dilapidated, and it seemed that no one had lived in it for a while.
Song Wen turned around and left Tongluo Lane.
The aunt said that Gou Hang moved away for more than 20 days, which should be around the time he was attacked by Tang Liang last time.
It is enough to show that Gou Hang is an extremely cautious person. He guessed that Song Wen might come to trouble him and moved out in advance.
Song Wen returned to the main road and when he passed by a ready-made clothing store, his mind changed and he went in.
After a while, he changed into a smart outfit and wore a bamboo hat on his head. There was tulle on the edge of the bamboo hat to cover his face. He looked a bit like a knight in the world.
Song Wen came all the way to a restaurant not far from the Tiansha Gang entrance and sat down by the window on the second floor of the restaurant.
The view from this location is excellent, and you can just see the gate of Tiansha Clan.
He waited for half a day, and it was not until the afternoon that he saw Gou Hang leading two of his men out of the Tiansha Gang.
Song Wen did not disturb the three of them, but kept falling far behind them.
He followed him from afternoon until dusk, and he finally got to see what a real gangster is.
Blackmailing small businessmen and hawkers, eating king's meals, molesting the little wife on the roadside, bullying beggars...
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, Song Wen would never have believed that someone could do so many bad things in just one afternoon.
Finally, the three of them walked into a cheap brothel. Just when Song Wen thought that he would have to wait outside the brothel for a long time, the three of them came out in less than a quarter of an hour.
"Fuck, did the tiger change? So fast!"
Song Wen couldn't help but complain, and then followed the three of them to a private house under the cover of night.
The private house is a bit low, with a total of three rooms. Only the main room in the middle has a door for entry and exit. The other two side rooms have no doors leading to the outside, only windows.
Gou Hang and his two men were all alone. During this period, the three of them lived in this private house.
Song Wen looked at the sky. It was already past midnight, and it was the time when the moon was dark and the wind was high, and people were killed.
Song Wen straightened his sleeves, concealed the packet of powder in his hand, stepped forward, and knocked on the door.
"Who is it? It's the middle of the night."
A strong man cursed and shouted while opening the door.
"Song...?"
The strong man was surprised when he saw Song Wen. He couldn't understand why Song Wen appeared at his door so late.
However, his words had not yet been spoken.
"Bang!"
Song Wen kicked him into the room and smashed him on the table behind him.
The movement quickly attracted the two people in the side room, and Gou Hang and another big man ran out of the side room.
Gou Hang was shocked when he saw Song Wen suddenly appearing.
"Song Wen, how did you find this place?"
Song Wen raised his left hand, and the powder was scattered all over the sky, heading straight towards Gou Hang. In an instant, the entire main room was filled with white powder.
This white powder is a mixture of lime and caustic soda.
The three people who were unaware were instantly attacked.
"Ah...my eyes..."
The three of them covered their eyes with their hands and made continuous sounds of pain. Blood flowed from the eyes of one of the big men.
"Song Wen, you despicable villain, what on earth do you want to do?" In panic, Gou Hang stepped back and asked sternly.
Gou Hang was still lucky that he had never had a direct conflict with Song Wen, trying to hide the truth and get through.
